children: Porch, Porch Reciprocal Exchange and StoneX Financial entered into an at-the-market distribution agreement covering up to 15 million Porch shares. The Reciprocal may sell up to 10 million shares it already holds, with proceeds intended in part to strengthen its admitted surplus and liquidity; Porch may separately sell up to 5 million newly issued shares for general corporate purposes. Porch will receive no proceeds from sales by the Reciprocal, and neither seller is obligated to sell.
: Support the Reciprocal's admitted surplus and liquidity, while providing Porch general-purpose capital
